headlines.title: 이형일 부총리 " 국민 주거안정에 가용자원 집중 투입 "
headlines.summary: 핵심요약 영등포 행복주택 현장 점검…수도권 2만 8천호 공급 속도 이형일(오른쪽) 부총리 겸 재정경제부 장관이 23일 청년.고령층 주거안정 지원 강화 일환으로 서울 영등포구 소재 나라키움 영등포복합청사를 방문해 행복주택을 둘러보며 관계자의 설명을 듣고 있다.

headlines.title: 한·일 재계 “ 신산업 공동개척해 ‘ 새로운 60년’ 만들자”
headlines.summary: 한경협-日게이단렌 회의 韓 CPTPP 가입 등 협력 한·일 경제계가 신시장·신산업을 공동 개척해 ‘새로운 60년’을 만들자는 데 뜻을 모았다. 글로벌 공급망 불안 등 공통 과제에 함께 대응하고, 양국 산업 역량을 결합해 글로벌 시장과 지역경제에서 새로운 성장 기회를 창출하자는 구상이다.

headlines.title: “ 환율 하락 장기화되면 내년 성장률 하방압력”
headlines.summary: 비반도체 업종이 특히 민감 최근 원·달러 환율의 가파른 하락세가 수출기업에 새로운 부담 요인으로 떠오르고 있다. 원화 강세에 따른 수출 충격은 시차를 두고 확대될 수 있어 비반도체 업종을 중심으로 수출 증가세가 둔화하고, 내년 경제성장률에도 하방 압력으로 작용할 수 있다는 지적이 제기된다.

headlines.title: 여야 “ 전기차 생산세액공제 반드시 올해 통과”

headlines.title: 건설사 지급보증에 도 이주비 금리 두배 급등…주택공급 가로막는 금융
headlines.summary: 정부, 주택 공급 서두르면서 부동산 금융 옥죄 정책 엇박자 정부가 주택 공급을 서두르면서도 부동산 금융은 조이는 정책 엇박자가 건설 현장 자금난을 키운다는 지적이 나온다. 이재명 대통령은 최근 공급 속도를 높이기 위한 금융 인센티브 확대를 주문했지만 공적 기금은 추가 지원 여력이 빠듯하고, 시중은행은 건설 관련 여신을 보수적으로 운용하고 있다.

key_headlines.title: South Korea to Treble Physical AI Budget to 3.1 Trillion Won
key_headlines.summary: The government plans to increase physical AI spending to over 3 times the current level, reaching 3.1 trillion won next year, with AI education budget set at 2.1 trillion won as part of efforts to find post-semiconductor growth drivers.

key_headlines.title: Won Appreciation Risks Downward Pressure on Next Year's Growth Rate
key_headlines.summary: The sharp decline in the dollar-won exchange rate poses new challenges for exporters, particularly non-semiconductor sectors, which may dampen export growth and create downward pressure on economic growth in 2027.

key_headlines.title: Q3 Economic Growth Forecast at 0.7% with Semiconductor Sector Leading
key_headlines.summary: South Korea's third quarter GDP growth is projected at 0.7%, higher than Q2's 0.6%, driven primarily by semiconductor companies Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix.

key_headlines.title: Construction Financing Constraints Hamper Housing Supply Despite Government Push
key_headlines.summary: Policy inconsistency between accelerating housing supply and tightening real estate financing is creating cash flow challenges at construction sites, with government incentives limited and commercial banks taking conservative lending stances.

key_headlines.title: Tech Stock Selloff Continues Amid Global Safety Asset Flight
key_headlines.summary: The KOSPI and KOSDAQ indices experienced significant declines following overnight tech stock crashes on Wall Street, with investors shifting to safe-haven assets including U.S. Treasuries as AI investment concerns persist.

sections.Hot Economy News: The South Korean government is dramatically scaling up investment in physical AI and next-generation technologies to secure post-semiconductor growth. With a tripled budget allocation to 3.1 trillion won for physical AI and 2.1 trillion won for AI education, the initiative aims to embed AI across manufacturing and robotics sectors. The Digital Economy Forum held on October 23 underscored the government's commitment to fostering inclusive AI-driven growth, with officials emphasizing the need to lead the AI era. This strategic pivot reflects growing concerns about diversifying Korea's economic base beyond semiconductors.
sections.Macro & Fiscal Policy: South Korea's third quarter GDP growth is estimated at 0.7%, exceeding the previous quarter's 0.6%, primarily driven by semiconductor exports from Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix. The Bank of Korea projects this year's growth at 3.7%, matching OECD forecasts, with next year's growth expected to exceed 3%. Officials noted that Japan's September inflation rose to 2.1%, exceeding the BOJ's price stability target. The government's petroleum price ceiling policy has been credited with reducing inflation by 0.6 percentage points, though officials emphasize this is a temporary measure rather than a long-term solution.
sections.Financial Markets: The KOSPI and KOSDAQ indices experienced sharp declines on October 23, with the KOSPI initially falling over 4% before recovering to close near the 5,550 level, while the KOSDAQ fell 1.6%. The selloff was triggered by overnight tech stock crashes on Wall Street, with semiconductor shares like Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix also weakening. U.S. Treasury yields dropped below 5% for the first time in a month as investors shifted to safe-haven assets, reflecting concerns about AI investment returns and geopolitical risks. The won-dollar exchange rate declined to 1,324.6 won, prompting renewed marketing of overseas stock ETFs among securities firms.
sections.Industry & Technology: SK On is experiencing a turnaround centered on its Hungary factory as electric vehicle demand surges among major clients, reversing years of challenges in the EV market. President Lee is scheduled to hold a summit with German Chancellor Mertz on October 29 to discuss cooperation in semiconductors, AI, batteries, and defense industries. Korea's strategic partnerships with advanced economies are intensifying, with emphasis on future technology collaborations including AI infrastructure and semiconductor development. European challenges are creating opportunities for Korean automotive and battery manufacturers to strengthen their global market position.
sections.Real Estate: The government is preparing comprehensive measures to address both housing price volatility and shortages, with the Land and Transportation Ministry acknowledging rapid apartment price increases in the Seoul metropolitan area. Sejong City is experiencing heightened apartment trading activity with first-round application competition rates averaging 14.21:1, significantly exceeding the national average of 5.67:1, driven by aging housing stock and limited new supply. Next week's apartment subscription market includes 5,555 units across eight nationwide locations, with major projects in Hwaseong and Busan's Haeundae district. The disconnect between government housing supply acceleration and restrictive real estate financing is constraining construction project cash flows.
sections.International Economy: Global investment funds are flowing toward safe-haven assets, particularly U.S. Treasuries, as investors react to AI sector concerns and Middle Eastern tensions. The U.S. Federal Reserve's FOMC meeting scheduled for next week is expected to maintain interest rates, with market focus on inflation signals. South Korea imposed maximum 33.67% anti-dumping tariffs on Chinese galvanized cold-rolled steel products and offset printing plates. Russia exported 40,000 tons of diesel to the United States following the Trump-Putin agreement on temporary sanctions relief, marking the first major export under the new arrangement.
sections.AI & Economy: Data center expansion driven by AI demand is creating emerging opportunities in industrial labeling solutions, as facilities require extensive cable and equipment identification systems. South Korea's data center count reached 182 facilities as of 2025, a 3.5-fold increase since 2000, with the government targeting 8.4GW and 550 trillion won in AI data center construction through 2029. Industrial label printer markets are experiencing growth alongside data center expansion. However, Tesla has reduced investment commitments by 5 billion dollars following earlier announcements about AI and robotics transformation, signaling a potential gap between ambitious goals and actual capital deployment in emerging tech sectors.
sections.Others: Hyundai Heavy Industries, Korea Midland Power, and other companies are gaining recognition for innovative human resources development strategies at global forums. AI data center technology is expanding beyond terrestrial infrastructure into satellite-based systems, with U.S. and Chinese companies launching GPU-equipped satellites to enhance computing capacity. The Future Preparedness Fund legislation faced procedural concerns when the Planning and Budget Ministry reportedly excluded Finance Ministry input, though officials indicated further inter-agency coordination at the legislative stage. IntopsG acquired ISO/IEC 42001 AI Management System certification, demonstrating commitment to ethical AI development and operational governance standards.
